record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: Do the functionals λΦ_{λ,p} Γ-converge, as λ→∞, to the Sobolev or BV energy: namely to u↦c_p||∇u||_{L^p}^p on W^{1,p}(Ω) and +∞ outside W^{1,p}(Ω) when p>1, and to u↦c_1||∇u||_M on BV(Ω) and +∞ outside BV(Ω) when p=1, for some positive constants c_p and c_1?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9.3 ([32, Section 7.3]). Does the family of functionals λΦ_{λ,p} converge as λ → ∞, in the sense of Γ-convergence, to the functional Ψ defined ... by cp ||∇u||^p_{Lp} on W1,p and +∞ otherwise, and for p = 1 by c1 ||∇u||M on BV and +∞ otherwise?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N\ge 1$, $p\ge 1$, and let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded open set (or, more generally, a measurable subset of $\mathbb{R}^N$). Fix a real exponent $\gamma>0$ and set $b=\gamma/p$. For a measurable function $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ define the difference quotient
$$Q_b u(x,y)=\frac{u(x)-u(y)}{|x-y|^{\,1+b}},\qquad x,y\in\Omega,\ x\ne y,$$
the superlevel set
$$E_{\lambda,b,\Omega}(u)=\bigl\{(x,y)\in\Omega\times\Omega:\ |Q_b u(x,y)|>\lambda\bigr\},$$
the weighted measure
$$\nu_\gamma(E)=\iint_E |x-y|^{-N+\gamma}\,dx\,dy,$$
and the nonlocal "tail" functional
$$\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u)\ :=\ \lambda^{p}\,\nu_\gamma\!\bigl(E_{\lambda,b,\Omega}(u)\bigr),\qquad \lambda>0.$$

Consider the family $\{\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}\}_{\lambda>0}$ of functionals on $L^p(\Omega)$ (resp. $L^1(\Omega)$ when $p=1$), endowed with the strong $L^p$ topology.

Question. Do there exist positive constants $c_p$ (depending only on $N$ and $p$) and $c_1$ such that:
\begin{enumerate}
\item If $p>1$, then $\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}\ \xrightarrow{\ \Gamma\ }\ \Psi_p$ as $\lambda\to\infty$, where
$$\Psi_p(u)=\begin{cases}c_p\,\|\nabla u\|_{L^p(\Omega)}^{\,p}, & u\in W^{1,p}(\Omega),\\ +\infty, & \text{otherwise};\end{cases}$$
\item If $p=1$, then $\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,1}\ \xrightarrow{\ \Gamma\ }\ \Psi_1$ as $\lambda\to\infty$, where
$$\Psi_1(u)=\begin{cases}c_1\,\|Du\|_{\mathcal{M}(\Omega)}, & u\in BV(\Omega),\\ +\infty, & \text{otherwise}?\end{cases}$$
\end{enumerate}
Here $\|Du\|_{\mathcal{M}(\Omega)}$ denotes the total variation of the Radon measure $Du$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and a 2025 preprint on characterizations of Sobolev norms and total variation via nonlocal functionals explicitly list the Γ-convergence of λΦ_{λ,p} to the Sobolev/BV energy as an open problem; only partial lower- and upper-bound results and pointwise limits are available, while the full Γ-convergence statement (with identification of the constants c_p, c_1) does not appear to be established.

status_evidence.title: Characterizations of the Sobolev norms and the total variation via nonlocal functionals, and related problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open Questions regarding whether lim sup / lim inf of Φ_λ(u) provides a lower bound for Sobolev/BV norms; Γ-convergence of Φ_λ to a multiple of the Sobolev norm or total variation, with exact constants unknown in many cases.
status_evidence.claim: The Γ-convergence of the nonlocal tail functionals λΦ_{λ,p} to a multiple of the Sobolev/BV energy is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: A new approach to Sobolev spaces and connections to Γ-convergence
status_evidence.snippet: Earlier work establishing Γ-convergence of related nonlocal functionals to local Sobolev energies, motivating analogous questions for the tail functionals Φ_{λ,p}.
status_evidence.claim: Related Γ-convergence results exist for other nonlocal functionals but do not cover the tail functionals λΦ_{λ,p}.
